author: TNN
description: S Jaishankar emphasized the uncertainties facing the world during his speech at the Kautilya Economic Conclave. Jaishankar called for diplomacy to resolve the Russia-Ukraine conflict, particularly concerning maritime security.

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: Nearly 23 years after the Tamil Nadu assembly's breach of privilege resolution, a Supreme Court hearing is scheduled. title: Legislative privilege vs free speech: Supreme Court 7-judge bench may close case

description: The Delhi High Court emphasized that foreign nationals do not have an inherent right to enter India. Justice Amit Mahajan pointed out that holding a visa does not ensure unconditional admission. The court noted various factors that could lead to denial of entry, including national security and public health. A plea by a Turkmenistan woman for reasons regarding her entry refusal was dismissed.
title: Visa doesn't create absolute right to enter India, says Delhi High Court

description: The National Household Travel Survey indicates that only 15% of workers use public transport for commuting. Student commuting patterns differ significantly, with 37% walking to educational institutions.

author: VISHANT AGARWALA
description: Nepal has suspended non-essential search operations after the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli floods that occurred on August 26. The floods resulted in 1,455 deaths, with 5,285 people still unaccounted for, including many foreign tourists. Among the missing individuals are 189 Indians, along with tourists from various other countries. The government has shifted its focus towards reconstruction and rehabilitation efforts rather than continuing search operations.

The area now spans a total of 3,078.6 acres, including parts of the former Whitworth Ranch. Future developments may introduce around 10 miles of trails aimed at hiking and birdwatching, along with potential facilities like a headquarters and camping sites. This initiative will help preserve natural resources and provide greater recreational opportunities.

description: BJP has chosen not to renominate Union ministers Hardeep Singh Puri and B L Verma for Rajya Sabha. This decision raises speculation about a possible reshuffle of the council of ministers by PM Narendra Modi. Since several ministers have been given organization roles, it indicates their continuation in government may be unlikely. Puri's term ends in November, and he may be reassigned for the Punjab assembly polls.

Former Supreme Court judge Rohinton Fali Nariman also voiced concerns about the democratic implications of voters being removed from lists.

author: TOI WORLD DESK

The complainant accused Azad of raping her under the pretext of marriage and claimed the police did not register an FIR. description: Sturgeon’s Law, often summarized as “90% of everything is crap,” was Theodore Sturgeon’s rhetorical response to critics who dismissed science fiction by highlighting its weakest examples. In today’s AI-driven publishing environment, the principle takes on new relevance as content becomes easier to produce and distribute. The challenge, therefore, is increasingly about finding worthwhile work rather than avoiding everything.

description: India and Canada are gearing up for the fifth session of negotiations on the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, which will take place in Ottawa. description: Uruguay’s football team explored Kolkata ahead of its October 6 friendly against India. Market analysts anticipate a possible interest rate increase following the upcoming monetary policy meeting, while the dollar index remains robust.

description: An intelligence officer from Israel's Unit 8200 has been acknowledged for issuing multiple warnings regarding the Hamas invasion prior to the catastrophic attack on October 7, 2023. Unfortunately, those alerts went unheeded, which led to a coordinated assault from Gaza, resulting in heavy casualties and numerous hostages. This incident has led to a critical examination of the systemic shortcomings within Israel's military intelligence operations.

description: A man from Noida was arrested for allegedly molesting two women in a Kolkata hotel lobby. The incident occurred shortly after a football match between Brazil and India. Police reviewed CCTV footage and identified the accused, Palash Ray, in the hotel. Ray denied the allegations, claiming any contact was accidental, and investigations are ongoing. The statements of the victims and witnesses will be recorded as part of the inquiry.

Almost 9.87 lakh people faced distress due to the floods impacting multiple districts.

description: A consumer commission in Kerala ruled in favor of a customer regarding an electric scooter. The customer experienced multiple defects, including poor battery performance and a defective wheel bearing system. After the commission's investigation, they found the manufacturer's service insufficient and defective. The company was ordered to refund Rs 88,000 and pay additional compensation and litigation costs. The manufacturer must comply within 45 days or face further financial penalties.

description: The Indian Air Force chief has highlighted the ongoing shortage of fighter aircraft within the organization. The current fleet consists of 29 fighter squadrons, much lower than the authorized strength. Efforts are underway to expedite the production of the Tejas Mark-1A and finalize the 114-aircraft Multi-Role Fighter Aircraft deal.
